question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Under the weather
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Under the weather"** means to feel unwell or sick. (बीमार महसूस करना)

 
 
• **Example: **I've been feeling **under the weather **since yesterday, so I decided to stay home from work.
 
 
 
• **"To feel unwell" **refers to a state of not feeling healthy or experiencing discomfort. (अस्वस्थ महसूस करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She has been **feeling unwell** and needs to see a doctor.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **To feel unwell.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To enjoy the weather **(मौसम का आनंद लेना): To take pleasure in the current weather conditions.

 
 
• **Example:** We went to the beach **to enjoy the weather.**
 
 
 
• **To feel secure **(सुरक्षित महसूस करना): To feel safe and free from danger or threat.
 
 
• **Example: **She **felt secure **knowing that the doors were locked.
 
 
 
• **To work against the weather** (मौसम के खिलाफ काम करना): To perform tasks despite unfavorable weather conditions.
 
 
• **Example:** The construction workers continued **to work against **the weather to complete the project on time.
 
 

3d:Tb57,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**
